step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify nodes from the whiteboard:
   - S3 (Green bucket icon, labeled 'S3')
   - EKS (Orange Kubernetes icon, labeled 'EKS')
   - HPC NODE (Compute icon, labeled 'HPC NODE', mapped to EC2)
   - CLOUDWATCH (Red icon, labeled 'CLOUDWATCH', mapped to CloudWatch)
   - LAMBDA (Bottom orange icon, labeled 'LAMBDA', mapped to Lambda)
   - LAMBDA (Top orange icon, labeled 'LAMBDA', mapped to Lambda)
   - SNS (Pink/red icon, labeled 'SNS', mapped to SNS)
   - DYNAMODB (Purple database icon, labeled 'DYNAMODB', mapped to DynamoDB)
2. Identify directed edges based on visible drawn arrows:
   - EKS -> HPC NODE (arrow down)
   - HPC NODE -> S3 (curved arrow left/up)
   - HPC NODE -> CLOUDWATCH (arrow right/up)
   - CLOUDWATCH -> LAMBDA (bottom) (arrow right/down)
   - LAMBDA (bottom) -> DYNAMODB (arrow down/left)
   - LAMBDA (bottom) -> SNS (arrow up/right)
   - SNS -> LAMBDA (top) (arrow up/left)
3. Sequence the flows logically starting from the orchestration/compute pipeline through monitoring, alerting, and data persistence.

graph.name: OnScale: Cloud HPC Orchestration
graph.notes: Architecture for orchestrating massive parallel HPC simulations using EKS, EC2, CloudWatch, Lambda, DynamoDB, and SNS.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Stores input simulation data and output results

nodes.name: EKS
nodes.notes: Orchestrates and spins up right-sized HPC nodes

nodes.name: CLOUDWATCH
nodes.notes: Ingests log streams and metrics from HPC nodes

nodes.name: LAMBDA (Bottom)
nodes.notes: Triggered by CloudWatch logs to process simulation status

nodes.name: DYNAMODB
nodes.notes: Stores simulation run records and timestamps

nodes.name: SNS
nodes.notes: Distributes notification events for downstream processing

edges.notes: HPC node writes simulation results back to S3
HPC node streams execution logs and status to CloudWatch
CloudWatch triggers Lambda on pattern match
Lambda records start/end timestamps and metadata in DynamoDB
Lambda publishes notification message to SNS
SNS triggers additional Lambdas for further processing
